tips.intro1: In visual mode select a UserTask, choose

tips.user: specified user; value is a comma-separated list of user IDs
tips.role: specified role; value is the role key, resolved by the engine to all users under that role
tips.dept: specified department; value is a comma-separated list of department IDs, resolved by the engine to all users under those departments
tips.initiator: the initiator themselves; value is ignored
tips.engineP1: At task creation the engine resolves assignees per task using the task-level extension properties above; the process-variable approach (pass
